hero.heading: Spaces that feel like you.
hero.copy: Thoughtful interiors, refined materials and timeless details — designed around the way you live.

about.label: 01 — THE STUDIO
about.heading: We design the feeling behind the space.
about.p1: MSC Mansion Space Creative Studio is an interior design studio creating sophisticated homes, workplaces and hospitality spaces with a strong sense of identity.
about.p2: From the first sketch to the final styling, we bring together architecture, materials, lighting and furniture to make every corner intentional.

services.label: 02 — WHAT WE DO
services.heading: One studio. Every detail.
services.intro: From a single room to a complete turnkey project, our services are built to make the design journey simple and beautifully considered.

items.title: Full Home Interiors
items.description: Complete design direction for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, wardrobes and every connecting space.

items.title: Modular Kitchens
items.description: Elegant, practical kitchens planned around your cooking style, storage needs and aesthetic.

items.title: Custom Wardrobes
items.description: Made-to-measure wardrobes, storage and TV units with precise proportions and premium finishes.

items.title: False Ceiling & Lighting
items.description: Layered ceilings, profile lights and feature lighting designed to make every room feel finished.

items.title: Complete Renovation
items.description: Transform an existing space with a fresh palette, lighting, finishes, furniture and artful styling.

items.title: Commercial Interiors
items.description: Workspaces, studios and commercial environments designed for brand presence, comfort and performance.

statement.quote: Good design is not about filling a room. It is about knowing what to leave out.

why.label: 04 — WHY MSC
why.heading: A studio approach with a clear point of view.
why.lead: We combine creative thinking with practical execution so the final space feels considered, not complicated.

features.title: Personal direction
features.description: Every project starts with your lifestyle, taste and aspirations.

features.title: Material intelligence
features.description: Textures, grains, stone, metal and light are selected as one composition.

features.title: End-to-end execution
features.description: A considered process from concept and drawings through installation and styling.

process.label: 05 — HOW IT WORKS
process.heading: A clear path to your new space.
process.intro: Our process keeps the creative experience exciting while every practical detail stays organised.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We understand your lifestyle, requirements, budget and design direction.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Concepts, layouts, materials, colours and 3D visualisations bring the idea to life.

steps.title: Refine
steps.description: We finalise details, specifications and a clear project scope together.

steps.title: Create
steps.description: Our execution team turns the approved design into a finished space.

estimate.label: 06 — ESTIMATE QUOTATION
estimate.heading: Get your interior estimate in 4 steps.
estimate.copy: Tell us about your home, choose your scope, add your approximate area and upload room or floor-plan photos. MSC will generate an indicative starting estimate.

contact.label: 07 — LET'S CREATE
contact.heading: Have a space in mind?
contact.copy: Tell us a little about your project. Our studio will get back to you to discuss the next step.
